<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="ultimate-slayer-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Ultimate Slayer Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/2DsYuqm.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>the Ultimate Slayer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is a title obtained by completing every slayer collection log item. After the wilderness update, it became a popular goal for many players as PvP can now be turned off. This guide contains all the tips and tricks to make the grind as smooth as possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This made tasks like Lava Strykewyrms, Revenants and Ripper demons a very safe and hassle-free task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ An overview of generally helpful slayer items/consumables/relics can be found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Task specific guides can be found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rs3-slayer</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="useful-items"><ins><nowiki>Useful Items</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Useful Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Items that will greatly assist the player's Ultimate Slayer journey.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Consumables - Time savers</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Fellstalk_incense_sticks <strong><nowiki>Fellstalk incense sticks</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265421213746.png?v=1" alt="fellstalksticks" title="fellstalksticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Each potency level provides a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>x1.01</nowiki></strong><nowiki> multiplier to elite NPCs spawn chance, up to ~4% (tiers stack multiplicatively).
    • Important item for tasks such as: Ripper Demons, Edimmu and Rune Dragons.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_VIP_ticket <strong><nowiki>Slayer VIP ticket</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344597934120.png?v=1" alt="slayervip" title="slayervip" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Usually obtained via the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Travelling_merchant <nowiki>Travelling Merchant</nowiki>]<nowiki> or </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Cabbage_Facepunch_Bonanza <nowiki>Cabbage Facepunch Bonanza</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
    • You can also kill the beginner version of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Giant_Mimic <nowiki>Giant Mimic</nowiki>]<nowiki> for ~30+ slayer VIP tickets per hour depending on luck.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Seeker's_charm <strong><nowiki>Seeker's Charm</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212537411932160.png?v=1" alt="seekerscharm" title="seekerscharm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Offering them to the northern portal in the stalker dungeon increases the chance of elite soulgazers appearing from 1/50 to 1/10.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Consumables - QoL</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Lantadyme_incense_sticks <strong><nowiki>Lantadyme incense sticks</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1" alt="lantasticks" title="lantasticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Extends potion timers up to +2 minutes at max potency - reduces the doses of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> used.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Potion_reservoir <strong><nowiki>Potion reservoir</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739200407654431.png?v=1" alt="potionreservoir" title="potionreservoir" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Allows for potions with a timer to be automatically consumed - Helps the grind become more AFK.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance <strong><nowiki>Penance powder</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Good for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upkeep.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other Untradeable items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Most_Wanted_card <strong><nowiki>Most wanted cards</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877256884867152.png?v=1" alt="mostwantedcardabbydemon" title="mostwantedcardabbydemon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877287327125594.png?v=1" alt="mostwantedcardautomaton" title="mostwantedcardautomaton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877303722659840.png?v=1" alt="mostwantedcardglacor" title="mostwantedcardglacor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877321212907561.png?v=1" alt="mostwantedcardtormenteddemon" title="mostwantedcardtormenteddemon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Obtained weekly from the platinum mode of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rush of Blood</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.
    • Increases unique droprates for their respective monsters.
    • Each card contains 100 charges, each kill of the monsters depletes 1 charge.
    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Multiple copies cannot be obtained.</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • Very good for Glacors </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107344935923743.png?v=1" alt="glacor" title="glacor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Automatons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107269820133477.png?v=1" alt="automaton" title="automaton" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_mask <strong><nowiki>Slayer Masks</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325563068071936.png?v=1" alt="maskoftheabyss" title="maskoftheabyss" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Allow players to force a task for the monster once a day. Read more in the following section.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="daily-slayer-mask-tasks"><ins><nowiki>Daily Slayer mask tasks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 2 main reasons to force 1 task per day with their respective slayer masks:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Easy points that adds up over time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Removes the need to use lower tier slayer masters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Most important:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Use slayer masks for monsters whose uniques are only obtainable on-task/have rates significantly boosted on task:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ice strykewyrm </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107267915907166.png?v=1" alt="icestrykewyrm" title="icestrykewyrm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Staff of light</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Desert strykewyrm </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107266313703566.png?v=1" alt="desertstrykewyrm" title="desertstrykewyrm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Focus sight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jungle strykewyrm </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107264459821066.png?v=1" alt="junglestrykewyrm" title="junglestrykewyrm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Hexcrest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Airut </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107275562139648.png?v=1" alt="airut" title="airut" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Razorback gauntlets </nowiki><strong><nowiki>(Only on task)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal demon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107332478840873.png?v=1" alt="abyssaldemon" title="abyssaldemon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Abyssal wand and orb </nowiki><strong><nowiki>(Only on task)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Other slayer masks such as Mask of Kurask/Basilisks/Stone provide a boost in drop chance for their respective head items.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="task-prioritisation"><ins><nowiki>Task prioritisation</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>**Disclaimer! This section assumes the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You own the Slayer master cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Laniakea </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1" alt="laniakea" title="laniakea" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is your main slayer master</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You are starting with mostly empty logs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Block/Prefer lists are based on task weighing and general level of annoyance of the task**</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Slayer master cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has a perk that gives a 20% chance to choose what a new task will be from a Slayer master. There are a couple of tasks that should have priority over others. The last thing you want is having little to no points with your last item being an Edimmu pet which can be very hard to obtain.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Block and Prefer Tasks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Ask questions if you get stumped
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Prefer List</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>• Ripper demons
• Demons cluster
• Strykewyrms cluster
• Lava Strykewyrms
• Dragons cluster
• Gemstone dragons
• Dinosaurs
• Edimmu (see below)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Block List</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>• Black demons
• Elves
• Greater Demons
• Dark beasts (after dark bow is obtained)
• Aviansies
• Gargoyles (after granite maul is obtained)
• Vyrewatch
• Crystal Shapeshifters (after elven ring is obtained)
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Undead cluster and Creatures of Daemonheim are also good prefer tasks to replace any monsters you finish before obtaining the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1" alt="edimmu" title="edimmu" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pet.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Priority (P) list if your cape procs:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P1: Edimmu </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1" alt="edimmu" title="edimmu" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P2: Ripper demons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1" alt="ripperdemon" title="ripperdemon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Demons cluster task</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P3: Camel Warrior </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107305173913721.png?v=1" alt="camelwarrior" title="camelwarrior" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Living Wyverns </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107283015421962.png?v=1" alt="livingwyvern" title="livingwyvern" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Lava Strykewyrms </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107339126808627.png?v=1" alt="lavastrykewyrm" title="lavastrykewyrm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Strykewyrms cluster, Dinosaurs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1" alt="venomousdinosaur" title="venomousdinosaur" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P4: Nightmare creatures </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107308516782111.png?v=1" alt="nightmare" title="nightmare" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Creatures of the Lost Grove </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107335343542404.png?v=1" alt="mossgolem" title="mossgolem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107312115490877.png?v=1" alt="vinecrawler" title="vinecrawler" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947789895606312.png?v=1" alt="luminoussnaggler" title="luminoussnaggler" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P5: Ascension creatures </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107271523020831.png?v=1" alt="rorarius" title="rorarius" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Celestial Dragons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212539441975296.png?v=1" alt="celestialdragon" title="celestialdragon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P6: Dragon cluster, Gemstone dragons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107337415544854.png?v=1" alt="hydrixdragon" title="hydrixdragon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P7: Anything that can be killed without a task and does not provide a drop boost on task (Stalker creatures, Kal'gerion demons, Tormented demons, Aquanites, Nihils, Glacors, Nodon Dragonkin...)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Tasks that can be toggled with slayer points should be turned off after obtaining their relevant drops.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="wilderness-tasks"><ins><nowiki>Wilderness tasks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>By doing tasks in the wilderness whenever feasible, you can obtain more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1" alt="revenantdropenhancer" title="revenantdropenhancer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for future revenant tasks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Tasks that should be done in the wilderness during Ultimate Slayer:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ripper demons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1" alt="ripperdemon" title="ripperdemon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lava Strykewyrms </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107339126808627.png?v=1" alt="lavastrykewyrm" title="lavastrykewyrm" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal Creatures </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107328964014100.png?v=1" alt="abyssalbeast" title="abyssalbeast" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107332478840873.png?v=1" alt="abyssaldemon" title="abyssaldemon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hydrix Dragons (optional) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107337415544854.png?v=1" alt="hydrixdragon" title="hydrixdragon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>Useful Spreadsheets
